proposal.reason: Primary change is a new built-in TROCE GIN backend (host/device GIN APIs, context/registration lifecycle, QP/CQ progress, signal/flush semantics, and internal GIN plugin wiring). Include network because the PR also makes substantive shared net_ib transport changes (provider detection, QP inline policy, verbs opcode support, NET↔GIN device mapping, and proxy signal-op handling) that affect network backend behavior beyond purely local refactors.
